@name: Performer
@slug: performer
@category: RMFRP Core
@default_cost: 32
@description:
 [Vocational] A performer is a character who makes it his business to
 entertain crowds, large or small. He will often be found in taverns or
 perhaps in organized theaters. He is a restless soul, however, and will
 seldom stay in one place for very long. Time to Acquire: 40 months. Starting
 Money: normal plus d10 (open-ended).
